interaction.arena-travel.line.original: Choose where to travel. Enter the hunting grounds for Behemoth encounters, or visit {{name:412a0cf5-2746-40e7-bfcf-8adb5e422469}} to practice.

interaction.guide.line.original: Welcome to {{name:d7a92efc-c62b-4467-bb6d-2bd5512ed46e}}. The market lanes climb around the old inn to the watchtower courtyard. Cross the western stream to explore the bridge quarter, visit the smithy behind the travel board, or meet the weapon masters on either side of the arrival square.

interaction.smith.line.original: The smith will craft and upgrade weapons using the parts you accumulate in the hunting grounds. Crafting is not available in this mockup.

interaction.armorer.line.original: The armorer will turn your gathered parts into armor and upgrades. Armor progression is not available in this mockup.

interaction.potions.line.original: Herbs, bottles and remedies are prepared here for hunters and arriving survivors. Potion crafting is not available in this mockup.

interaction.sword.line.original: Practice {{name:88f5b91e-e1ca-4d3d-8b0d-8ecf452c13f4}} (LLL), {{name:5d3498d7-4eef-4010-a57a-8aa72b04695c}} (LHH), and {{name:0218e254-ff60-49e6-af85-9b8f17ac65bd}} (HHH) in {{name:412a0cf5-2746-40e7-bfcf-8adb5e422469}}. Each completed combo earns its own Mantra.

interaction.repeaters.line.original: {{name:600ea7ea-5045-4803-b118-1f4ab72c76bf}} reward close positioning: reload near your target for empowered shots. {{name:412a0cf5-2746-40e7-bfcf-8adb5e422469}} is available for practice.

interaction.chains.line.original: Use heavy strikes to wound, hits to build resources, and Q to push off before an airborne return or slam. Practice in {{name:412a0cf5-2746-40e7-bfcf-8adb5e422469}}.

interaction.future-master.line.original: A station reserved for a future weapon master. Three weapons currently have masters in {{name:d7a92efc-c62b-4467-bb6d-2bd5512ed46e}}.

interaction.refugee.line.original: A Behemoth destroyed our settlement. We brought what we could carry. Refugees will arrive on and off with requests for help; quests are not available in this mockup.

interaction.travel.line.original: Choose {{name:71d642cf-1562-4a25-b467-acd81e6e74a6}} to enter the hunting grounds, or {{name:412a0cf5-2746-40e7-bfcf-8adb5e422469}} to train. Hunting grounds support continuing encounters until you choose to return.
